scientific_integrity: Explicitly credits the published forbidden-prefix decomposition and stabilization proof; all novel assertions are the coefficient identification, effective threshold and global summatory exponent. Exact integer computation corroborates finite cases but is not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: The formula concerns the stabilized correction in finite signed Fibonacci string counts, not general asymptotics in the jointly growing integer and length regime. The summatory law is a two-sided power order only; no leading constant or pointwise asymptotic is claimed. Historical priority may be limited by unindexed equivalent digit-partition statements.
title: An explicit generating product and growth law for stabilized signed Fibonacci forcing
